parsed.name: 化学气相沉积控制器
parsed.description: 用于化学气相沉积（CVD）实验的工艺控制装置，可管理气体流量、温度设定以及配方运行，并监视过程趋势。
parsed.description_en: A process controller for chemical vapor deposition (CVD) experiments, used to manage gas flows, temperature setpoints, and recipe execution while monitoring process trends.
